clips.title: The story
paras: Grunt Dogran waits in captivity deep in the southern Barrens. Once assigned to the Crossroads and then Camp Taurajo, he was taken during a patrol into Agama'gor.

Grunt Dogran was sent from the Crossroads to reinforce Camp Taurajo after rising in the Horde military. He led a detachment of grunts into Agama'gor, where they met the Bristleback quilboar in a fierce clash. Dogran was badly wounded and crippled. His comrades retreated without him, and the quilboar dragged him into captivity.
